definitions.explanation: Used to add information to what has already been said.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。それに⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧。
examples.english: He is smart. Moreover, he is kind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。それに⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: It's cold today. Besides, it's also raining.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧し、それに⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{美味|おい}しくない→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: It's expensive, and moreover, it's not very tasty.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。それに⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant is cheap. Besides, the portions are big.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。それに⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}かけない→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I don't have time. Besides, the weather is bad too, so I decided not to go out today.

notes:
それに is a conjunction meaning 'moreover' or 'besides,' used to add supporting information to what was already said. It can add both positive and negative points.

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
Typically appears at the start of a new sentence or clause: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。それに⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。(It's cheap. Besides, it's delicious.)

USAGE:
- Can stack reasons for or against: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧し、それに⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧ (it's expensive, and on top of that, far away)
- Natural in both spoken and written Japanese
- Slightly more casual than ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: moreover (more formal, written)
- ⟦さらに→さらに：03817_sarani⟧: furthermore (adds degree or quantity)
- ⟦しかも→しかも：03818_shikamo⟧: moreover (emphasizes something surprising or noteworthy)
- ⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: in addition (formal, often written)
- ⟦おまけに→おまけに：21779_omakeni⟧: on top of that (colloquial, often negative)
